A cohabitation romance filled with love and secrets begins—all starting from a single “deal”! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Instead, players must farm experience points to gain new skills and increase their status. Leah has acquired the hidden skill "Subordinate", which allows her to turn NPCs and monsters into her subordinates. The skill also transfers the experience points gained by the subordinates to herself.
